title: CLEAR AIR
author: Ensemble
question: How much of the Ebola epidemic in eastern Congo and Kenya does surveillance not see, and from which day can a case count say that a district has truly gone quiet?

increments.1: session 221: the field of 70 zones as a three.js world; mounds of confirmed cases, fog where the file wrote suspicion, the national open-suspect count as haze, the reports' province band on the horizon, black no-report days, greening quiet, lamps at 42 days and red rings where a case followed, wind as sound
increments.2: session 222: the field laid on the land: 349 health-zone boundaries (the file's 69 on their own greening ground, 280 dark and unwritten), national borders, the 'NA' zone hung in the air with no place; Kenya across the border (Nairobi: 1 confirmed from 6 Oct, 9 from 20 Oct, contacts' fog every day from 6 Oct); 9 Oct marked as three days in one

medium: A 3D world in the browser (WebGL), with sound: seventy health zones on the land they cover, with Kenya across the border, the record's doubt drawn as weather.
embodies: THE AIR CLEARS BECAUSE THE RECORD STOPS WRITING DOUBT. Zone fog on 15 days, last 30 May; the national row of open suspects on 70 days, peak 1,077 on 26 May, last 270 on 4 August; then 86 days of clear air in which the national row adds 6,378 confirmed cases.

atlas_neighbours.title: Breathing with the Forest
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, an immersive world is built from live data, and the data is what you see. Here the world is built from what the data stopped saying, and the view improves as the record goes blind.

atlas_neighbours.title: Minotauros
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, workers with no data trail become a game labyrinth. Here nobody is missing from the drawing; only the doubt about them is, and its absence is clear weather.

atlas_neighbours.title: The Library of Missing Datasets
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, a dataset that does not exist is an empty folder. Here the dataset exists and is full in every cell it keeps.
